description: This file implements the core functions of a STUN (Simple Traversal of UDP through NATs) client, including role engagement, binding discovery, maintaining bindings, binding change notification, and asynchronous binding lifetime discovery. It defines several key functions such as StunScoPlayRole1, StunScoDiscoverBinding, StunScoMaintainBinding, StunScoNotifyBindingChange, and StunScoAsyncDiscoverTask, which handle different stages of NAT traversal and binding management in a VoIP or similar UDP-based application.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS StunScoPlayRole1(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initiates the STUN client activity, resetting internal states and timers, setting up the stage timer, and starting the discovery of the NAT binding.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS StunScoDiscoverBinding(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Starts the process to discover the NAT binding by sending a STUN Binding Request, constructing the request with attributes like USERNAME and optionally MESSAGE-INTEGRITY, and handling the response.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS StunScoDiscoverBindingTimeoutA(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Sends a specific binding discovery request without RESPONSE-ADDRESS attribute and with message integrity, to determine the NAT binding's lifetime.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS StunScoDiscoverBindingTimeoutB(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Sends a binding request including RESPONSE-ADDRESS attribute with message integrity, used for additional NAT binding lifetime discovery.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS StunScoMaintainBinding(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Sends a binding request to maintain or refresh the NAT binding, including attributes like USERNAME, optional CONNECTION-REQUEST-BINDING, and MESSAGE-INTEGRITY.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS StunScoNotifyBindingChange(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Notifies the remote server of changes in NAT binding by sending a binding request with relevant attributes.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS StunScoAsyncDiscoverTask(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous task to discover the NAT binding's lifetime by dynamically adjusting timers and port usage, following procedures similar to RFC 3489, including sending binding requests via multiple sockets and interpreting responses to adapt discovery parameters.
